story: Li Yuan had taken Chang'an at the end of 617 and ruled through a puppet Sui emperor. In the spring of 618 news came that Emperor Yang had been strangled at Jiangdu by his own guards, led by Yuwen Huaji. Li Yuan then had the boy emperor abdicate and took the throne himself, naming his dynasty Tang after his old title.

The new emperor, Gaozu, did not yet rule China. Rival regimes held most of the country. Over the next six years his sons, especially Li Shimin, defeated them one by one: Xue Ju in the northwest, Liu Wuzhou in Shanxi, and in 621 both Wang Shichong at Luoyang and Dou Jiande, whose relief army Li Shimin crushed at Hulao Pass.
story_zh: 617年底，李渊攻下长安，通过一个傀儡皇帝号令天下。618年春，传来消息：隋炀帝在江都被宇文化及率领的禁军缢杀。李渊随即让小皇帝退位，自己登基，以原先的封号“唐”为国号。
新皇帝唐高祖此时还远未统一天下，全国大部分地方仍被各路割据势力占据。此后六年间，他的儿子们，尤其是李世民，逐一消灭了这些对手：西北的薛举，山西的刘武周，621年又先后击败洛阳的王世充和窦建德，李世民在虎牢关大破窦建德的援军。
tang-founded.why: The Tang lasted nearly three centuries and is remembered as one of the high points of Chinese civilisation.
tang-founded.why_zh: 唐朝延续了近三百年，被视为中华文明的高峰之一。

story: Li Shimin had won most of the Tang's wars, but his elder brother Li Jiancheng was crown prince, and the two had built rival factions. Their younger brother Li Yuanji sided with Jiancheng. By 626 each side feared the other would strike first.

On the morning of 2 July 626, Li Shimin and his officers waited inside the Xuanwu Gate, the northern entrance to the palace. When his brothers rode in to meet their father, Li Shimin shot Jiancheng dead, and his general Yuchi Jingde killed Yuanji. Jiancheng's sons and Yuanji's sons were also put to death.
Three days later Emperor Gaozu named Li Shimin crown prince, and two months after that he gave up the throne to him.
story_zh: 李世民为唐朝打下了大半江山，但太子是他的哥哥李建成，兄弟二人各自结党，弟弟李元吉站在太子一边。到626年，双方都担心对方会先下手。
626年7月2日清晨，李世民带着部下埋伏在宫城北门玄武门内。哥哥和弟弟骑马入宫朝见父亲时，李世民一箭射死李建成，大将尉迟敬德杀死了李元吉。两人的儿子们也随后被处死。
三天后，唐高祖立李世民为太子；又过了两个月，便把皇位传给了他。
xuanwu-gate.why: As Emperor Taizong, Li Shimin ruled until 649. His Zhenguan reign became the model of wise government, though it began with the killing of his brothers.
xuanwu-gate.why_zh: 李世民即唐太宗，在位至649年。他的贞观之治成为后世贤明政治的典范，尽管这一切始于手足相残。

people.name: Li Shimin
people.role: Prince of Qin, later Emperor Taizong

story: Xuanzang was a Buddhist monk troubled by the contradictions in Chinese translations of the scriptures. In 629 he left Chang'an to find the original texts in India, even though travel beyond the frontier was forbidden. He crossed the Gobi alone, was helped by the king of Gaochang, and passed through the Tianshan, Samarkand and the Hindu Kush.

In India he studied for about five years at the great monastery of Nalanda under the teacher Śīlabhadra, and he won fame in debates at the court of King Harsha. In 645 he returned to Chang'an with 657 texts. Emperor Taizong welcomed him, and he spent the rest of his life translating, while his travel account, the Great Tang Records on the Western Regions, was written up with his disciple Bianji.
story_zh: 玄奘是一位佛教僧人，他发现汉译佛经中有许多相互矛盾之处，于是决心去印度求取原典。629年，在朝廷禁止出境的情况下，他悄悄离开长安，独自穿越戈壁，得到高昌王的资助，又翻越天山，途经撒马尔罕，越过兴都库什山。
在印度，他在那烂陀寺师从戒贤法师学习了约五年，还在戒日王主持的辩论大会上声名远扬。645年，他带着657部经卷回到长安，受到唐太宗的接见。此后他余生都在翻译佛经，并口述西行见闻，由弟子辩机笔录成《大唐西域记》。
xuanzang.why: His translations reshaped Chinese Buddhism, and his record is still a key source for the history of Central Asia and India.
xuanzang.why_zh: 他的译经深刻影响了中国佛教，他的游记至今仍是研究中亚和印度历史的重要资料。

story: In 626, just after Taizong took the throne, the Eastern Turkic ruler Illig Qaghan rode right up to the Wei River outside Chang'an, and the new emperor had to buy him off. Over the next few years heavy snows killed Turkic herds, and vassal tribes rose against Illig.

In the winter of 629 to 630 Taizong struck. The general Li Jing led a small cavalry force through the snow and made a surprise night attack on Illig's camp. Illig fled toward the Yin Mountains, where Li Jing and Li Shiji caught his army off guard while he was pretending to negotiate. Illig was captured that spring and brought to Chang'an.
The chiefs of the steppe tribes then gave Taizong the title Heavenly Qaghan.
story_zh: 626年，唐太宗刚即位，东突厥颉利可汗就率军直抵长安城外的渭水边，太宗只好以财物换取退兵。此后几年，大雪冻死了突厥大批牲畜，附属部落又纷纷反叛颉利。
629年至630年冬，太宗出兵反击。大将李靖率领轻骑踏雪奔袭，夜袭颉利大营。颉利逃往阴山，一面假意求和，一面准备再逃，结果被李靖和李勣趁其不备击溃。这年春天，颉利被俘，押送长安。
草原各部首领随后尊唐太宗为“天可汗”。
eastern-turks.why: The victory removed the main threat from the north and opened the way for Tang expansion into the Western Regions.
eastern-turks.why_zh: 这场胜利消除了北方的主要威胁，为唐朝向西域扩张打开了道路。

story: Gaochang, near modern Turpan, was a rich oasis kingdom ruled by a Chinese family, the Qu. Its king Qu Wentai had helped Xuanzang, but he later allied with the Western Turks and blocked other states' envoys and merchants travelling to Tang. In 640 Taizong sent the general Hou Junji across the desert. Qu Wentai died of illness as the army approached, and his son surrendered.

Against the advice of some ministers, Taizong made Gaochang a regular prefecture and set up the Anxi ('Pacify the West') Protectorate there. After Tang destroyed the Western Turkic Khaganate in 657, the protectorate moved to Kucha in 658 and oversaw the Four Garrisons of Kucha, Khotan, Kashgar and Karashahr.
story_zh: 高昌位于今吐鲁番附近，是一个由汉人麴氏统治的富庶绿洲王国。国王麴文泰曾经资助过玄奘，后来却与西突厥结盟，阻拦西域各国前往唐朝的使者和商人。640年，唐太宗派大将侯君集率军穿越沙漠讨伐。唐军逼近时，麴文泰病死，他的儿子开城投降。
太宗不顾部分大臣反对，在高昌故地设立西州，并设安西都护府。657年唐朝灭西突厥汗国后，安西都护府于658年迁到龟兹，统辖龟兹、于阗、疏勒、焉耆四镇。
anxi.why: For more than a century the protectorate gave Tang control of the Tarim Basin and its Silk Road cities.
anxi.why_zh: 此后一百多年，安西都护府使唐朝控制着塔里木盆地及丝绸之路上的城市。

story: Songtsen Gampo had united Tibet and wanted a Tang princess as a sign of equal standing with the Turkic and Tuyuhun rulers who had received one. When his first request was refused he attacked the Tang border at Songzhou in 638. His minister Gar Tongtsen then came to Chang'an with rich gifts, and Taizong agreed.

Princess Wencheng, a young woman of the imperial clan, set out in 641, escorted by Li Daozong, Prince of Jiangxia. Songtsen Gampo met her at the edge of his kingdom. Tibetan tradition says she brought a famous statue of the Buddha, now in the Jokhang temple, along with books, seeds and craftsmen. She lived in Tibet for nearly forty years and died there in 680.
story_zh: 松赞干布统一吐蕃后，希望像突厥和吐谷浑的君主那样娶一位唐朝公主，以示地位平等。初次求婚被拒后，他在638年进攻唐朝边境的松州。随后他派大相禄东赞带着厚礼来到长安，唐太宗终于应允。
文成公主是唐朝宗室之女，641年在江夏王李道宗护送下启程。松赞干布亲自到边境迎接。按照藏族传统说法，她带去了一尊著名的释迦牟尼像（今供奉在大昭寺），还有书籍、种子和工匠。她在吐蕃生活了近四十年，680年在那里去世。
wencheng.why: The marriage became a lasting symbol of friendship between Tibetans and Han Chinese, though war between Tang and Tibet resumed after Songtsen Gampo's death.
wencheng.why_zh: 这次和亲成为汉藏友好的长久象征，不过松赞干布死后，唐蕃之间又起战端。

story: In 660 a Tang army under Su Dingfang landed in Korea and, together with Silla, destroyed the kingdom of Baekje. Baekje loyalists fought on and asked Japan, Baekje's old ally, for help. Japan sent troops and returned the Baekje prince Buyeo Pung, who had lived at the Japanese court, to lead the restoration.

In 663 the Japanese fleet sailed to the mouth of the Baekgang (the Geum River) to relieve the Baekje forces. A smaller Tang fleet under Liu Rengui was waiting in formation. In four clashes the Tang ships trapped the Japanese and burned about 400 of their vessels. Buyeo Pung fled to Goguryeo, and the Baekje resistance collapsed.
story_zh: 660年，苏定方率唐军渡海进入朝鲜半岛，与新罗联手灭了百济。百济遗民继续抵抗，并向老盟友倭国（日本）求援。日本出兵相助，还把一直留居日本朝廷的百济王子扶余丰送回国主持复国。
663年，日本船队驶向白江口（今锦江入海口）增援百济军。刘仁轨指挥的唐朝船队虽然数量较少，却早已严阵以待。双方四次交战，唐军围住日本船队，焚毁其船只约四百艘。扶余丰逃往高句丽，百济复国运动随之瓦解。
baekgang.why: Japan withdrew from Korean affairs for centuries and built coastal defences and a centralised state modelled on Tang.
baekgang.why_zh: 此后几百年，日本不再插手朝鲜半岛事务，转而修筑沿海防御，并仿照唐朝建立中央集权国家。

story: Wu Zhao entered the palace as a junior consort of Taizong and became Emperor Gaozong's empress in 655. After Gaozong fell ill around 660 she handled much of the government. When he died in 683 she deposed one son, Zhongzong, within weeks and kept another, Ruizong, as a figurehead.

In 690 she declared a new dynasty, Zhou, and took the title of emperor herself, the only woman in Chinese history to do so. She ruled mainly from Luoyang, which she called Shendu, the 'divine capital'. She used informers and secret police against opponents, but also promoted able officials such as Di Renjie, expanded the examinations and lavishly supported Buddhism.
In 705, old and ill, she was forced out by a palace coup and died that year.
story_zh: 武曌最初是唐太宗的才人，655年成为唐高宗的皇后。约660年高宗患病后，朝政多由她处理。683年高宗去世，她在几周内废黜了儿子唐中宗，又立另一个儿子唐睿宗作为傀儡。
690年，她改国号为周，自己登基称帝，成为中国历史上唯一的女皇帝。她主要坐镇洛阳，称之为“神都”。她任用酷吏、鼓励告密，打击异己，但也提拔了狄仁杰等能臣，扩大科举取士，并大力扶持佛教。
705年，年老多病的武则天在宫廷政变中被迫退位，同年去世。
wu-zetian.why: Her reign weakened the old aristocracy and brought new men into government, and the Tang name was restored after her.
wu-zetian.why_zh: 她的统治削弱了旧门阀，让一批新人进入朝廷；她退位后，唐朝国号得以恢复。

story: By the start of the eighth century the Anxi Protectorate at Kucha was responsible for an enormous area, from the oases of the Tarim Basin to the grasslands where the Western Turkic tribes grazed. In 702 Wu Zetian's court created a second protectorate at Tingzhou, near modern Jimsar, on the northern side of the Tianshan.

Beiting ('northern court') supervised the Turkic tribes of Dzungaria and guarded the road west to the Ili valley. It became a grand protectorate, and from the 710s a military governor based there commanded tens of thousands of troops.
After the An Lushan rebellion its garrison was cut off from China by Tibet, but it held out for more than thirty years until it fell around 790.
story_zh: 到八世纪初，驻在龟兹的安西都护府管辖的范围极其辽阔，从塔里木盆地的绿洲一直延伸到西突厥各部放牧的草原。702年，武则天的朝廷在天山北麓的庭州（今吉木萨尔附近）另设北庭都护府。
北庭都护府负责管理准噶尔一带的突厥部落，并守卫通往伊犁河谷的道路。它后来升为大都护府，从710年代起，驻在这里的节度使统领着数万兵马。
安史之乱后，北庭被吐蕃隔断，与中原失去联系，但仍坚守了三十多年，约在790年失陷。
beiting.why: With Anxi, Beiting marked the furthest lasting reach of Tang rule into Central Asia.
beiting.why_zh: 北庭与安西一起，标志着唐朝在中亚持久统治所达到的最远范围。

story: Li Longji, a grandson of Wu Zetian, came to power through two palace coups, against Empress Wei in 710 and against his aunt Princess Taiping in 713. That year he began the Kaiyuan reign, which lasted until 741.

With capable chancellors such as Yao Chong and Song Jing, he cut waste, checked the power of the imperial relatives and registered households that had slipped off the tax rolls. Granaries filled, prices were low, and Chang'an, with about a million people, drew merchants, monks and students from across Asia. It was the age of the poets Li Bai, Du Fu and Wang Wei, and of the painter Wu Daozi.
In his later years Xuanzong left government to the chancellor Li Linfu and spent his time with Yang Guifei.
story_zh: 李隆基是武则天的孙子，他通过两次宫廷政变上台：710年诛灭韦后，713年铲除姑母太平公主。这一年，他改元开元，开元年号一直用到741年。
他任用姚崇、宋璟等贤相，裁减冗费，抑制外戚和宗室，清查逃离户籍的人口。粮仓充盈，物价低廉，长安人口约百万，吸引着来自亚洲各地的商人、僧侣和留学生。这是李白、杜甫、王维等诗人的时代，也是画家吴道子的时代。
到了晚年，唐玄宗把朝政交给宰相李林甫，自己终日与杨贵妃为伴。
kaiyuan.why: The Kaiyuan years are remembered as the peak of Tang power and culture, made more poignant by the disaster that followed in 755.
kaiyuan.why_zh: 开元年间被视为唐朝国力和文化的顶峰；755年随之而来的大乱，更让后人对这段盛世感慨不已。

quote.zh: 忆昔开元全盛日，小邑犹藏万家室。稻米流脂粟米白，公私仓廪俱丰实。
quote.en: I remember the days of Kaiyuan at its height: even a small town held ten thousand households. The rice ran with oil and the millet was white; public and private granaries alike were full.
quote.from: Du Fu, Remembering the Past 杜甫《忆昔》

story: In 750 Gao Xianzhi, the Korean-born commander of the Anxi Protectorate, attacked the city-state of Chach (Tashkent), took its king to Chang'an, where he was executed, and seized its treasures. The king's son appealed to the Abbasid Caliphate, which had just taken power in the Islamic world.

In July 751 Gao's army, including allied Karluk Turks, met an Abbasid army under Ziyad ibn Salih near the Talas River. After several days of fighting the Karluks changed sides and attacked the Tang troops from behind. Gao's army was routed, and he escaped with only a few thousand men.
Among the captives was Du Huan, who later returned by sea and wrote an account of the Arab lands.
story_zh: 750年，出身高句丽的安西节度使高仙芝进攻石国（今塔什干），把国王押送长安处死，并夺取了石国的财宝。石国王子逃出后，向刚刚在伊斯兰世界建立统治的阿拔斯王朝求援。
751年7月，高仙芝率领包括葛逻禄部落在内的军队，在怛罗斯河附近与齐雅德·伊本·萨利赫指挥的阿拔斯军队相遇。激战数日后，葛逻禄部临阵倒戈，从背后袭击唐军。唐军大败，高仙芝只带着几千人逃回。
被俘的唐军中有一个叫杜环的人，后来经海路回国，写下了记述阿拉伯世界的《经行记》。
talas.why: The battle marked the limit of Tang power in Central Asia; a later tradition credits Chinese captives with bringing papermaking to Samarkand.
talas.why_zh: 这场战役标志着唐朝在中亚势力的极限；后世传说被俘的唐朝工匠把造纸术带到了撒马尔罕。

story: An Lushan, a general of Sogdian and Turkic descent, rose through Xuanzong's favour to command three frontier circuits in the northeast, with well over 150,000 troops. He clashed bitterly with Yang Guozhong, the cousin of Yang Guifei, who had become chief minister.

In December 755 An rebelled at Fanyang, near modern Beijing, claiming he had come to remove Yang Guozhong. His veteran army swept across the North China Plain and took Luoyang within weeks. In 756 he proclaimed himself emperor of Yan, broke through Tong Pass and seized Chang'an.

The war dragged on for eight years. An Lushan was murdered by his son in 757, and his general Shi Siming carried on the fight. The rebellion ended only in 763, with Uyghur help and many rebel generals bought off with governorships.
story_zh: 安禄山是粟特与突厥混血的将领，深得唐玄宗宠信，同时兼任东北三镇节度使，手下兵力超过十五万。他与杨贵妃的堂兄、宰相杨国忠势同水火。
755年12月，安禄山在范阳（今北京一带）起兵，打着讨伐杨国忠的旗号。他的精兵横扫华北平原，几周内就攻下洛阳。756年，他自称大燕皇帝，随后突破潼关，攻占长安。
战乱持续了八年。757年安禄山被自己的儿子杀死，部将史思明继续作战。直到763年，唐朝借助回纥兵力，并以节度使之职招降了许多叛将，叛乱才告平息。
an-lushan.why: The rebellion broke central control, left the northeast under semi-independent governors and cost Tang its western lands to Tibet.
an-lushan.why_zh: 这场叛乱摧毁了中央集权，使河北一带落入半独立的藩镇之手，唐朝的西部领土也被吐蕃夺去。

people.name: An Lushan
people.role: Rebel general, self-proclaimed emperor of Yan
people.role_zh: 叛乱将领，自称大燕皇帝

quote.zh: 国破山河在，城春草木深。
quote.en: The nation is broken, but the hills and rivers remain; spring comes to the city, and grass and trees grow thick.
quote.from: Du Fu, Spring View 杜甫《春望》

story: When Tong Pass fell in the summer of 756, Xuanzong slipped out of Chang'an before dawn with Yang Guifei, her cousin Yang Guozhong, a few princes and a small guard. The next day they reached Mawei Station, west of the capital. The soldiers were hungry and angry, and blamed the Yang family for the disaster.

Led by their commander Chen Xuanli, the guards killed Yang Guozhong and refused to go further. They then demanded the death of Yang Guifei. The old emperor gave in, and the eunuch Gao Lishi strangled her in a Buddhist shrine at the station. She was thirty-seven.
Xuanzong went on to Sichuan, while the crown prince turned north and soon made himself emperor.
story_zh: 756年夏，潼关失守，唐玄宗在黎明前悄悄逃出长安，随行的有杨贵妃、她的堂兄杨国忠、几位皇子和少量禁军。第二天，一行人到达长安西面的马嵬驿。将士们又饿又怒，把这场灾难归咎于杨氏一家。
在禁军将领陈玄礼带领下，士兵杀死杨国忠，拒绝继续前进，接着又要求处死杨贵妃。年迈的玄宗只得让步，宦官高力士在驿站的佛堂里将她缢死，时年三十七岁。
玄宗随后继续逃往四川，太子则转向北方，不久自行即位。
mawei.why: The story of the emperor and his lost consort became one of the great love tragedies of Chinese literature.
mawei.why_zh: 皇帝与爱妃生离死别的故事，成为中国文学中最著名的爱情悲剧之一。

quote.zh: 六军不发无奈何，宛转蛾眉马前死。
quote.en: The six armies would not move; nothing could be done. The lovely lady with moth-like brows died before the horses.
quote.from: Bai Juyi, Song of Everlasting Regret 白居易《长恨歌》

story: To fight An Lushan, the Tang pulled its best troops from the western frontier. The Tibetan Empire under Trisong Detsen took advantage, capturing one Tang prefecture after another in the northwest.

In the autumn of 763, the year the rebellion ended, a large Tibetan army with Tuyuhun and other allies advanced on Chang'an, guided by a Tang officer who had defected. Emperor Daizong fled east to Shanzhou. The Tibetans entered the capital, plundered it and placed a Tang prince on the throne as a puppet. After about fifteen days, with Guo Ziyi gathering troops nearby, they withdrew.
Over the next decades Tibet took the whole Hexi Corridor, ending with Dunhuang in 786.
story_zh: 为了对付安禄山，唐朝把西部边境的精锐部队都调往东方。赤松德赞统治下的吐蕃趁虚而入，在西北接连攻取唐朝州县。
763年秋，也就是安史之乱结束的那一年，吐蕃联合吐谷浑等部组成大军，在一名降将的引导下进逼长安。唐代宗东逃陕州。吐蕃军进入都城，大肆劫掠，还立了一位唐朝宗室作傀儡皇帝。大约十五天后，郭子仪在附近集结兵马，吐蕃军撤走。
此后几十年里，吐蕃夺取了整个河西走廊，最后一个陷落的是786年的敦煌。
tibet-changan.why: The occupation showed how weak the Tang had become, and the loss of the northwest cut China's land link to Central Asia for nearly a century.
tibet-changan.why_zh: 这次失陷暴露了唐朝的虚弱。西北的丧失使中国与中亚的陆路联系中断了近一个世纪。

story: Early Tang taxes were based on the equal-field system: each adult man was supposed to receive land from the state and paid the same fixed dues in grain, cloth and labour. The war of 755 to 763 drove millions from their homes, the land registers fell apart, and much of the tax burden fell on those who stayed put.

In 780 the new emperor Dezong adopted a plan by his chief minister Yang Yan. Households were now taxed where they actually lived, according to their land and wealth, whether or not they were native to the place. Taxes were assessed in money and collected twice a year, in summer and autumn, and each region was given a fixed quota.
story_zh: 唐朝前期的赋税建立在均田制之上：每个成年男子理论上从国家领取土地，交纳同样数额的粮食、布帛和劳役，也就是租庸调。755年到763年的战乱使数以百万计的人流离失所，户籍和田册一片混乱，赋税负担大多落在没有逃走的人身上。
780年，新即位的唐德宗采纳宰相杨炎的建议，实行两税法：不论原籍何处，各户都在实际居住地按田亩和资产多少纳税；税额以钱计算，每年夏、秋两季征收，并给各地规定了定额。
two-tax.why: Taxing property rather than persons became the basic principle of Chinese taxation until the Ming's Single Whip reform and beyond.
two-tax.why_zh: 按资产而不是按人头征税，此后成为中国税制的基本原则，一直延续到明代一条鞭法乃至更晚。

people.name: Yang Yan
people.role: Chief minister who designed the reform

story: After the An Lushan rebellion, Tibet captured the Hexi Corridor city by city: Liangzhou in 764, Ganzhou and Suzhou in 766, Guazhou in 776. Dunhuang, then called Shazhou, at the far western end, was left on its own.

Its people held out for about a decade. When the governor Zhou Ding planned to burn the city and flee, he was killed, and the officer Yan Chao took command. With food and arms running out, Yan Chao finally negotiated a surrender, on condition that the people would not be moved away. The usual date is 786, although some historians argue for 781.
Under Tibetan rule Buddhism flourished, and new caves continued to be carved and painted at the Mogao Caves.
story_zh: 安史之乱后，吐蕃逐城攻取河西走廊：764年取凉州，766年取甘州、肃州，776年取瓜州。位于最西端的敦煌（当时叫沙州）成了一座孤城。
城中军民坚守了约十年。刺史周鼎打算焚城出逃，被部将杀死，由阎朝接掌城防。粮尽械竭之际，阎朝与吐蕃谈判，以“勿徙他境”为条件开城投降。通常认为这发生在786年，也有学者认为是781年。
在吐蕃统治下，佛教依然兴盛，莫高窟仍在不断开凿新的洞窟、绘制壁画。
dunhuang-tibet.why: Its fall completed Tibet's control of the Hexi Corridor and cut the Tang off from its remaining garrisons in Central Asia.
dunhuang-tibet.why_zh: 敦煌的陷落使吐蕃完全控制了河西走廊，唐朝与中亚残存驻军的联系被彻底切断。

story: Emperor Wuzong was a devoted follower of Daoism and listened to the Daoist priest Zhao Guizhen. His chancellor Li Deyu also saw the monasteries as a drain on the state: they held huge tax-free estates and many monks and nuns paid no taxes. The court began restricting Buddhism in 842.

In 845 came the great decree. According to the official figures, more than 4,600 monasteries and some 40,000 shrines were destroyed, over 260,000 monks and nuns were returned to lay life, and their lands and bronze were taken by the state. Foreign religions such as Manichaeism, Zoroastrianism and the Church of the East were also banned. The Japanese monk Ennin, then in China, recorded the events in his diary.
Wuzong died in 846, and his successor eased the ban.
story_zh: 唐武宗笃信道教，宠信道士赵归真。宰相李德裕也认为寺院拖累国家：它们占有大量免税田产，众多僧尼不纳赋税。从842年起，朝廷就开始限制佛教。
845年，朝廷颁布大规模毁佛诏令。据官方统计，全国拆毁寺院四千六百多所、招提兰若四万余处，二十六万多名僧尼被勒令还俗，寺院田产和铜器全部收归国家。摩尼教、祆教和景教等外来宗教也一并被禁。当时正在中国的日本僧人圆仁在日记中记下了这些情形。
846年武宗去世，继位的唐宣宗放宽了禁令。
huichang.why: Chinese Buddhism never regained its former wealth, and the foreign religions of Tang China almost disappeared.
huichang.why_zh: 中国佛教再也没能恢复往日的财力，唐朝境内的各种外来宗教也几乎消失殆尽。

story: In the 840s the Tibetan Empire fell into civil war after the death of its last king, Langdarma. In 848 Zhang Yichao, a leading man of a local Chinese family in Dunhuang, led an uprising that drove the Tibetan garrison out of the city.

He sent envoys to Chang'an by several routes; one group reached the capital in 851 with maps and registers of the prefectures he had recovered. Emperor Xuanzong made him military governor of a new Guiyi ('return to allegiance') Circuit. Zhang went on to take more of the Hexi Corridor, including Liangzhou in 861.
In 867 he went to Chang'an himself and stayed there until his death in 872, while his family ruled Dunhuang.
story_zh: 840年代，吐蕃末代赞普朗达玛死后，吐蕃陷入内战。848年，敦煌当地汉人大族的首领张议潮发动起义，把吐蕃守军赶出了沙州城。
他分几路派使者前往长安，其中一路在851年抵达京城，献上收复各州的地图和户籍。唐宣宗任命他为新设的归义军节度使。此后张议潮又收复了河西走廊的更多地方，861年攻下凉州。
867年，他亲自入朝长安，一直住到872年去世，敦煌则由他的家族继续统治。
zhang-yichao.why: The Guiyi Circuit kept Dunhuang linked to China for more than 150 years, and its records survive in the Mogao library cave.
zhang-yichao.why_zh: 归义军使敦煌与中原的联系维持了一百五十多年，相关文书保存在莫高窟藏经洞中流传至今。

people.name: Zhang Yichao
people.role: Leader of the uprising, Guiyi governor
people.role_zh: 起义领袖，归义军节度使

story: The Diamond Sutra is a short Buddhist scripture about the emptiness of all things. A copy printed from carved wooden blocks onto seven sheets of paper, glued into a scroll about five metres long, carries a note saying that Wang Jie had it made on the fifteenth day of the fourth month of the ninth year of Xiantong, which is 868. It opens with a fine picture of the Buddha preaching.

The scroll was one of tens of thousands of documents sealed in a side cave at the Mogao Caves around the year 1000. The Daoist priest Wang Yuanlu found the cave in 1900, and in 1907 the explorer Aurel Stein took the scroll to Britain. It is now in the British Library.
story_zh: 《金刚经》是一部讲“一切皆空”的简短佛经。敦煌发现的这件刻本由七张纸粘接成卷，长约五米，用雕刻好的木版印成。卷末题记说，它是王玠在咸通九年四月十五日出资刻印的，即公元868年。卷首还有一幅精美的佛陀说法图。
这卷经书与数万件文书一起，大约在公元1000年前后被封存在莫高窟的一个小洞窟里。1900年，道士王圆箓发现了藏经洞；1907年，探险家斯坦因把这卷经书带到英国，现藏于大英图书馆。
diamond-sutra.why: Its skilled printing shows that woodblock printing was already mature in Tang China, centuries before printing in Europe.
diamond-sutra.why_zh: 它精湛的印刷工艺表明，雕版印刷在唐代就已十分成熟，比欧洲早了几个世纪。

people.name: Wang Jie
people.role: Donor who paid for the printing

people.name: Aurel Stein
people.role: Explorer who took it to Britain
people.role_zh: 将其带往英国的探险家

quote.zh: 咸通九年四月十五日王玠为二亲敬造普施。
quote.en: Reverently made for universal free distribution by Wang Jie on behalf of his two parents, on the fifteenth day of the fourth month of the ninth year of Xiantong.
quote.from: Colophon of the Dunhuang Diamond Sutra 敦煌《金刚经》题记

story: By the 870s the Tang was weighed down by drought, famine, heavy taxes and the hated state salt monopoly. In 874 or 875 the salt smuggler Wang Xianzhi rose in revolt in the Shandong and Henan region, and Huang Chao, also a salt trader who had failed the imperial examinations, joined him with his own followers from Caozhou.

Rather than holding territory, the rebels moved fast across the country, plundering as they went. After Wang Xianzhi was killed in 878, Huang Chao led the movement south as far as Guangzhou, then back north, and in 880 he took both Luoyang and Chang'an.
Driven out of the capital in 883 by Tang forces and the Shatuo Turk Li Keyong, he was cornered near Mount Tai and died in 884.
story_zh: 到870年代，唐朝饱受旱灾、饥荒、苛捐杂税之苦，官府垄断的盐价更是民怨沸腾。874年或875年，私盐贩子王仙芝在今山东、河南一带起义；同样贩过私盐、屡试不第的黄巢，也带着曹州的追随者加入进来。
起义军不占据地盘，而是流动作战，所到之处大肆掳掠。878年王仙芝战死后，黄巢率众南下，一直打到广州，又回师北上，880年先后攻占洛阳和长安。
883年，唐军和沙陀首领李克用把他赶出长安。884年，黄巢在泰山附近陷入绝境而死。
huang-chao.why: The rebellion destroyed what was left of central authority; the generals who crushed it, such as Zhu Wen and Li Keyong, became the warlords who ended the Tang.
huang-chao.why_zh: 这场起义摧毁了唐朝仅存的中央权威；镇压起义的朱温、李克用等人，后来成了终结唐朝的军阀。

people.name: Zhu Wen
people.role: Rebel officer who defected to Tang
people.role_zh: 投降唐朝的起义军将领

story: In 879 Huang Chao asked the court to make him governor of Guangzhou, the empire's richest port. When the court offered him only a minor officer's post in the crown prince's guard, his army stormed the city that autumn.

Guangzhou had a large community of foreign traders, including Arabs, Persians, Jews and Christians. The Arab writer Abu Zayd al-Sirafi later reported that 120,000 foreigners were killed, a figure historians think is exaggerated. He also wrote that the rebels cut down the mulberry trees of the region, ruining the silk trade.
The hot, humid climate brought disease, and many of Huang Chao's northern soldiers died. Within months he led his army back north toward the Yangtze.
story_zh: 879年，黄巢向朝廷要求出任广州节度使，这里是帝国最富庶的港口。朝廷只肯授予他率府率这样一个东宫小武官，起义军便在这年秋天攻破了广州。
广州有大批外国商人，包括阿拉伯人、波斯人、犹太人和基督徒。阿拉伯作家阿布·赛义德后来记载说，有十二万外国人遇害，史学家认为这个数字有所夸大。他还写道，起义军砍掉了当地的桑树，使丝绸贸易遭到重创。
岭南湿热，疫病流行，黄巢手下的北方士兵病死了许多。几个月后，他便率军北返，向长江进发。
guangzhou-sack.why: The massacre and the chaos that followed damaged China's sea trade with the Islamic world for a generation.
guangzhou-sack.why_zh: 这场屠杀及随后的动荡，使中国与伊斯兰世界的海上贸易在约一代人的时间里遭受重创。

people.name: Abu Zayd al-Sirafi
people.role: Arab writer who reported the massacre
people.role_zh: 记载此事的阿拉伯作家

story: In 880 Huang Chao's army, said to number several hundred thousand, crossed the Huai, took Luoyang without a fight and broke through Tong Pass. Emperor Xizong and his powerful eunuch Tian Lingzi fled to Chengdu, as Xuanzong had done more than a century earlier.

Huang Chao entered Chang'an and proclaimed himself emperor of a new dynasty, Great Qi. At first his men handed out goods to the poor, but soon they were looting the city and killing members of the Tang clan and officials. In 881, when the townspeople welcomed briefly returning Tang troops, the rebels took bloody revenge.
The poet Wei Zhuang, trapped in the city, later described its ruin in a long poem.
story_zh: 880年，号称数十万的黄巢大军渡过淮河，兵不血刃拿下洛阳，又攻破潼关。唐僖宗和权宦田令孜逃往成都，与一百多年前唐玄宗的出逃如出一辙。
黄巢进入长安，称帝建国，国号大齐。起初起义军还向穷人散发财物，不久便在城中劫掠，诛杀唐朝宗室和官员。881年，城中百姓曾欢迎短暂入城的唐军，起义军回来后进行了血腥报复。
被困城中的诗人韦庄，后来写下长诗《秦妇吟》，描绘了长安的惨状。
huang-chao-changan.why: Chang'an never recovered its old splendour, and from then on the Tang survived only by relying on warlords.
huang-chao-changan.why_zh: 长安从此再也没有恢复昔日的繁华，唐朝此后只能依靠军阀苟延残喘。

quote.zh: 内库烧为锦绣灰，天街踏尽公卿骨。
quote.en: The palace storehouses were burned to ashes of brocade; on the imperial avenue one trod on the bones of high officials.
quote.from: Wei Zhuang, Lament of the Lady of Qin 韦庄《秦妇吟》

story: The early Tang emperors revised the Sui laws several times, in 624, 637 and 651. Because judges across the empire read the articles in different ways, Emperor Gaozong ordered his uncle Zhangsun Wuji and a team of officials to write an official commentary. It was presented in 653 and given the force of law alongside the code.

The code had 502 articles in twelve sections, covering everything from palace security and households to theft, fighting and the duties of officials. Punishments depended on rank and on family relationships: a son who struck his father was punished far more severely than a stranger. Because the code and commentary were preserved together, they are known today as the Tanglü Shuyi.
story_zh: 唐初几位皇帝分别在624年、637年和651年修订过律令。由于各地官员对律文的理解不一，唐高宗命舅舅长孙无忌等人为律文撰写官方注释，653年完成颁行，与律文具有同等法律效力。
唐律共十二篇、五百零二条，从宫廷警卫、户籍婚姻到盗窃斗殴、官员职守，无所不包。量刑轻重要看身份等级和亲属关系：儿子殴打父亲，所受刑罚远比打陌生人重。由于律文和注释一起保存了下来，今天人们称之为《唐律疏议》。
tang-code.why: It is the oldest Chinese code to survive complete, and it shaped later Chinese codes and the laws of Japan, Korea and Vietnam.
tang-code.why_zh: 它是现存最早的完整中国法典，深刻影响了后世中国法典以及日本、朝鲜、越南的法律。

story: Goguryeo, the powerful kingdom of northern Korea and southern Manchuria, had defeated the Sui and fought off Taizong's own invasion in 645 at the fortress of Ansi. After the fall of Baekje, Tang and its ally Silla could attack from two directions.

The decisive break came after the death of Goguryeo's strongman Yeon Gaesomun around 666. His sons fought each other, and the eldest, Yeon Namsaeng, defected to Tang. The veteran general Li Shiji led a Tang army across the Liao River, while Silla attacked from the south. In the autumn of 668 Pyongyang fell and King Bojang was taken prisoner.
Tang set up a protectorate in Pyongyang, but Silla soon turned on its ally and drove Tang out of most of the peninsula by 676.
story_zh: 高句丽雄踞朝鲜半岛北部和中国东北南部，曾经打败隋朝，645年又在安市城击退了唐太宗的亲征。百济灭亡后，唐朝与盟友新罗可以从南北两面夹击。
转折点出现在约666年高句丽权臣渊盖苏文死后。他的几个儿子争权内斗，长子渊男生投降唐朝。老将李勣率唐军渡过辽河，新罗军从南面进攻。668年秋，平壤陷落，宝藏王被俘。
唐朝在平壤设立安东都护府，但新罗很快与唐反目，到676年把唐军逐出了半岛大部分地区。
goguryeo-falls.why: Goguryeo's fall ended the Three Kingdoms period of Korea and led to Silla's unification of most of the peninsula.
goguryeo-falls.why_zh: 高句丽的灭亡结束了朝鲜半岛的三国时代，此后新罗统一了半岛的大部分地区。

people.name: Yeon Namsaeng
people.role_zh: 投唐的高句丽权臣之子

story: Buddhist caves had been cut into the limestone cliffs at Longmen, south of Luoyang, since the Northern Wei. Under Emperor Gaozong the court began its grandest project there: an open-air shrine, later known as the Fengxian Temple, with a seated Vairocana Buddha about 17 metres high, flanked by disciples, bodhisattvas and guardian kings.

An inscription records that in 672 Empress Wu contributed 20,000 strings of cash from her own allowance for cosmetics, and that the work was finished in 675. The Buddha's calm, full face is often said to resemble the empress herself, though there is no proof of this.
Over the centuries the Longmen Grottoes grew to more than 100,000 statues.
story_zh: 自北魏以来，人们就在洛阳南面龙门的石灰岩山崖上开凿佛窟。唐高宗时，朝廷在这里开始了规模最大的一项工程：一座露天佛龛，后来称为奉先寺，主尊卢舍那佛坐像高约17米，两旁是弟子、菩萨和天王。
据碑文记载，672年武后捐出脂粉钱两万贯资助工程，675年完工。大佛面容丰满、神情安详，常有人说是照着武则天的模样雕刻的，不过这一说法并无证据。
经过历代开凿，龙门石窟中的造像总数超过十万尊。
longmen-vairocana.why: The Vairocana group is the masterpiece of Tang Buddhist sculpture and the centrepiece of a World Heritage site.
longmen-vairocana.why_zh: 奉先寺卢舍那佛群像是唐代佛教雕塑的巅峰之作，也是龙门石窟这一世界遗产的核心。

story: An old rule in Chinese astronomy said that the noon shadow of a standard eight-foot gnomon changed by one inch for every thousand li travelled north or south. Doubts had been raised before, and Emperor Xuanzong asked the Buddhist monk Yixing, a brilliant mathematician, to reform the calendar.

In 724 Yixing organised teams to measure the noon shadow at the solstices and the height of the Pole Star at stations stretching from Jiaozhou in modern Vietnam to the far north of the steppe. The officer Nangong Yue led the key measurements at four places on the plains of Henan. Comparing the results, Yixing showed that the old rule was wrong and calculated that one degree of latitude was about 351 li.
He used the work for his new Dayan calendar.
story_zh: 中国古代天文学有一条旧说：标准的八尺表杆在正午投下的影子，南北每相距一千里，长度就相差一寸。前人已经对此产生过怀疑。唐玄宗请精通数学的高僧一行主持修订历法。
724年，一行组织人员在从交州（今越南境内）到北方草原深处的多个地点，测量冬至、夏至正午的日影长度和北极星的高度。其中最关键的是南宫说在河南平原上四个地点进行的测量。一行比较结果后证明旧说不成立，并算出子午线上一度约合三百五十一里。
他把这些成果用于编制新的《大衍历》。
yixing-survey.why: It was the first scientific measurement of a meridian arc in history, about a century before the Abbasid survey under al-Ma'mun.
yixing-survey.why_zh: 这是世界上第一次用科学方法实测子午线长度，比阿拉伯阿拔斯王朝马蒙时期的测量早约一百年。

people.name: Nangong Yue
people.role: Official who led the Henan measurements

story: The early Tang relied on militia soldiers who farmed in peacetime and served in turns. As wars on the frontiers grew longer and more distant, this system broke down. From around 710 the court set up permanent frontier commands, each under a military governor called a jiedushi, and in the 720s it began recruiting paid professional soldiers.

By 742, the first year of the Tianbao era, there were ten great frontier commands with about 490,000 troops and 80,000 horses, while the capital region had far fewer. The chancellor Li Linfu encouraged the emperor to give these posts to non-Han generals, who he thought would be loyal and could not threaten his own position at court. One of them was An Lushan.
story_zh: 唐朝前期依靠府兵制：兵士平时务农，轮番服役。随着边境战争越打越久、越打越远，这套制度逐渐瓦解。约从710年起，朝廷在边疆设立常驻军镇，由节度使统领；720年代，又开始招募领饷的职业兵。
到742年，也就是天宝元年，边疆已有十大军镇，共有兵约四十九万、马八万匹，而京畿一带的兵力远远不及。宰相李林甫劝玄宗多用胡人将领担任节度使，认为他们忠心可靠，又不会威胁自己在朝中的地位。安禄山就是其中之一。
ten-jiedushi.why: Concentrating the empire's best troops under a few frontier generals made the An Lushan rebellion possible.
ten-jiedushi.why_zh: 帝国的精兵集中在少数边将手中，为安史之乱埋下了伏笔。

story: Li Bai, already famous for his free-spirited poems about wine, the moon and mountains, had spent about two years at court in Chang'an as a member of the Hanlin Academy. In 744 he was sent away with a gift of gold. That summer, in Luoyang, he met Du Fu, eleven years younger and still unknown.

The two travelled together through the region of Kaifeng and Shangqiu with the poet Gao Shi, drinking, hunting and climbing old terraces. They met again in Shandong the next year and then parted for good.
Du Fu never forgot the meeting. He wrote more than a dozen poems about Li Bai, praising his genius and worrying about him in exile. Li Bai wrote only a few in return.
story_zh: 李白以描写美酒、明月、山川的飘逸诗篇闻名天下，此前曾在长安做了约两年翰林供奉。744年，他被“赐金放还”，离开朝廷。这年夏天，他在洛阳遇到了比他小十一岁、尚且默默无闻的杜甫。
两人与诗人高适结伴，在梁宋（今开封、商丘一带）漫游，饮酒、打猎、登临古迹。第二年他们又在山东相聚，此后便再未相见。
杜甫始终没有忘记这段交往，前后写了十几首怀念李白的诗，称赞他的才华，牵挂他的流放生涯；李白回赠杜甫的诗却只有寥寥几首。
li-bai-du-fu.why: The friendship between China's two greatest poets became a celebrated story in itself, and their works defined classical Chinese poetry.
li-bai-du-fu.why_zh: 中国两位最伟大诗人之间的友谊本身就成了一段佳话，他们的作品代表了中国古典诗歌的最高成就。

quote.zh: 白也诗无敌，飘然思不群。
quote.en: Li Bai's poetry has no equal; his thoughts drift free, unlike any other's.
quote.from: Du Fu, Thinking of Li Bai on a Spring Day 杜甫《春日忆李白》

story: In 742 two Japanese monks, Yōei and Fushō, came to Yangzhou and asked the respected teacher Jianzhen to send someone to Japan to establish proper monastic ordination. When none of his disciples volunteered, Jianzhen decided to go himself.

His first five attempts failed: officials stopped him, a disciple betrayed him, and storms wrecked his ships, once blowing him all the way to Hainan. Yōei died, and Jianzhen lost his sight. In 753, aged about sixty-five, he slipped aboard a returning Japanese embassy ship and reached Kyushu at the end of the year.
In Nara he set up an ordination platform at Tōdai-ji, where he ordained the retired Emperor Shōmu, and in 759 founded the Tōshōdai-ji temple, where he died in 763.
story_zh: 742年，日本僧人荣睿、普照来到扬州，恳请德高望重的鉴真大师派人到日本传授正规的戒律。弟子们无人应允，鉴真便决定亲自前往。
前五次东渡都失败了：有时被官府阻拦，有时被弟子告发，有时船只遭遇风暴，有一次甚至被吹到了海南岛。荣睿在途中去世，鉴真也双目失明。753年，年约六十五岁的鉴真登上返航的日本遣唐使船，于年底抵达九州。
在奈良，他在东大寺设立戒坛，为退位的圣武天皇授戒；759年又创建唐招提寺，763年在寺中圆寂。
jianzhen-japan.why: Jianzhen brought Buddhist discipline, architecture, medicine and art to Japan, where he is still honoured.
jianzhen-japan.why_zh: 鉴真把佛教戒律以及建筑、医药和艺术带到日本，至今仍受到日本人民的崇敬。

people.name: Emperor Shōmu
people.role_zh: 接受他授戒的日本太上天皇

story: Lu Yu was an orphan raised by a Buddhist monk at Jingling in modern Hubei. He ran away as a boy, spent time with travelling actors, and after the An Lushan rebellion settled in the Huzhou region of the lower Yangtze, an area of tea hills. There, around 760 to 780, he wrote the Classic of Tea; it is hard to date exactly.

In three short volumes and ten chapters it describes the tea plant, the tools for picking and pressing leaves into cakes, the right water, the brewing method, the history of tea drinking and the best tea-growing regions. Lu Yu treated tea as an art and a moral discipline, not just a drink.
The book made him famous. Later generations honoured him as the 'Sage of Tea'.
story_zh: 陆羽是个孤儿，在竟陵（今湖北天门）被一位僧人收养。他少年时离寺出走，跟过戏班子；安史之乱后，定居在长江下游盛产茶叶的湖州一带。大约在760年到780年间，他在那里写成《茶经》，确切年份已难考证。
全书分三卷十章，讲述了茶树的特性、采茶和压制茶饼的工具、煮茶用水、煎茶方法、饮茶的历史以及各地名茶。在陆羽笔下，茶不只是一种饮料，更是一门艺术和修身之道。
这部书让陆羽名声大振，后人尊称他为“茶圣”。
classic-of-tea.why: Tea became a national drink and a major source of state revenue: a tea tax was introduced in 782, and tea later travelled to Tibet, Central Asia and Japan.
classic-of-tea.why_zh: 茶从此成为全国性的饮品和朝廷的重要财源：782年开始征收茶税，茶叶后来又传到吐蕃、中亚和日本。

people.name: Lu Yu
people.role: Author of the Classic of Tea

quote.en: Tea is a fine tree of the south.
quote.from: Lu Yu, Classic of Tea 陆羽《茶经》

story: The Church of the East, a Syriac-speaking Christian church centred in Persia, sent a monk named Alopen to Chang'an in 635. Emperor Taizong let him translate scriptures and in 638 allowed a monastery to be built. The Chinese called the faith Jingjiao, the 'luminous religion'.

In 781 the community set up a stone tablet almost three metres tall in Chang'an. Its Chinese text, composed by the monk Jingjing (Adam), summarises Christian teaching in Buddhist and Daoist terms and lists the emperors who had favoured the church. Names of clergy are also written in Syriac.
The stone was probably buried during the persecution of 845. It was dug up in the 1620s and is now in the Forest of Steles Museum in Xi'an.
story_zh: 东方教会是以波斯为中心、使用叙利亚语的基督教派。635年，该教会的修士阿罗本来到长安。唐太宗允许他翻译经典，638年又准许他修建寺院。中国人称这种宗教为“景教”。
781年，长安的景教徒立起一块近三米高的石碑。碑文由景净撰写，借用佛教和道教的词汇概述基督教教义，并列举了历代支持景教的皇帝。碑上还用叙利亚文刻着教士的名字。
这块碑很可能在845年会昌毁佛时被埋入地下，17世纪20年代出土，现藏于西安碑林博物馆。
nestorian-stele.why: It is the earliest surviving record of Christianity in China and evidence of how cosmopolitan Tang Chang'an was.
nestorian-stele.why_zh: 这是现存最早的关于基督教在华传播的记录，也见证了唐代长安的开放与多元。

people.name: Alopen
people.role: First Church of the East missionary in Chang'an
people.role_zh: 最早到长安的景教传教士

story: Famen Temple, west of Chang'an, kept what was believed to be a finger bone of the Buddha. Every thirty years or so it was brought to the capital. In early 819 Emperor Xianzong had it carried into the palace with great ceremony, and crowds burned their heads and arms and gave away their savings in devotion.

Han Yu, a vice minister and the leading champion of plain 'ancient-style' prose and Confucian values, sent in a memorial. He called the Buddha a foreigner who knew nothing of the duties between ruler and subject, and suggested throwing the bone into the water or fire. The furious emperor wanted to execute him. Ministers pleaded for him, and he was instead sent to govern Chaozhou, in the far south.
story_zh: 长安西面的法门寺供奉着一枚据说是佛陀指骨的舍利，每隔约三十年迎入京城一次。819年初，唐宪宗以盛大仪式把佛骨迎进宫中供奉，百姓争相烧顶灼臂、倾家布施。
刑部侍郎韩愈是倡导质朴“古文”、维护儒家价值的领袖人物，他上了一道表章，说佛本是夷狄之人，不懂君臣之义，主张把佛骨投入水火之中。宪宗大怒，要处死他。经大臣们求情，韩愈被贬为潮州刺史，远赴岭南。
han-yu-buddha-bone.why: Han Yu's defence of Confucian tradition against Buddhism helped pave the way for the Neo-Confucian revival of the Song.
han-yu-buddha-bone.why_zh: 韩愈捍卫儒家传统、排斥佛教的主张，为宋代理学的兴起开辟了道路。

quote.zh: 一封朝奏九重天，夕贬潮州路八千。
quote.en: In the morning I sent one memorial up to the ninefold heaven; by evening I was banished to Chaozhou, eight thousand li away.
quote.from: Han Yu, Demoted and Arriving at Languan Pass 韩愈《左迁至蓝关示侄孙湘》

story: For most of the century after 755, Tang and Tibet fought over the northwest and the Sichuan frontier. Both empires were exhausted, and Tibet's Buddhist king Ralpacan wanted peace.

In 821 Tibetan envoys and Tang officials swore a treaty at a ceremony in Chang'an, and in 822 a Tang delegation repeated the oath near Lhasa. The two rulers, whose families had been linked by marriage, called each other uncle and nephew. The treaty fixed the border roughly along existing lines and promised that neither side would raid the other.
In 823 the text was carved in Chinese and Tibetan on a stone pillar outside the Jokhang temple in Lhasa, where it still stands.
story_zh: 755年后的近一百年里，唐朝与吐蕃为争夺西北和川西边境连年交战。双方都已精疲力竭，信奉佛教的吐蕃赞普赤祖德赞也希望和平。
821年，吐蕃使者与唐朝官员在长安举行仪式会盟，822年唐朝使团又在逻些附近重申盟誓。两国王室曾有联姻，因此双方以“舅甥”相称。盟约大体按照当时的实际控制线划定边界，约定互不侵扰。
823年，盟文用汉、藏两种文字刻在拉萨大昭寺前的石碑上，这块碑至今犹存。
tang-tibet-treaty.why: The treaty brought lasting peace on the frontier, and its bilingual pillar is a key source for Tibetan history and language.
tang-tibet-treaty.why_zh: 这次会盟使唐蕃边境长期保持和平，那块双语石碑也成为研究吐蕃历史和语言的重要资料。

story: After the An Lushan rebellion, palace eunuchs gained control of the Shence Army, the main force guarding the capital, and with it the power to choose emperors. Emperor Wenzong resented them and secretly plotted with two officials, Li Xun and Zheng Zhu, to wipe them out.

In December 835 Li Xun announced that sweet dew, a sign of heaven's favour, had appeared on a pomegranate tree in a courtyard of the palace guard. The leading eunuch Qiu Shiliang was sent to look, intending that soldiers hidden there would kill him. But a breeze lifted a curtain, the eunuchs saw armed men, and they fled back, seizing the emperor. Shence troops then killed Li Xun, several chancellors and more than a thousand officials and their families.
story_zh: 安史之乱后，宦官掌握了守卫京城的主力神策军，也就掌握了废立皇帝的大权。唐文宗对此十分不满，暗中与李训、郑注两位官员策划，准备一举铲除宦官。
835年12月，李训奏称金吾卫院中的石榴树上降了甘露，这是上天赐福的祥瑞。文宗派大宦官仇士良前去查看，打算让埋伏的士兵趁机将他杀死。不料一阵风吹起帐幕，宦官们发现了伏兵，急忙逃回，挟持了皇帝。随后神策军大开杀戒，李训、几位宰相以及一千多名官员和家属遇害。
ganlu-incident.why: The failure left the eunuchs in firm control of the court for the rest of the dynasty.
ganlu-incident.why_zh: 政变失败后，宦官牢牢控制朝廷，直到唐朝灭亡。

story: The Uyghur Khaganate ruled the Mongolian steppe from 744 from its capital Ordu-Baliq on the Orkhon River. It sent cavalry to help Tang retake Chang'an and Luoyang during the An Lushan rebellion, and in return grew rich from trading horses for Chinese silk. Its rulers adopted Manichaeism.

In the 830s the khaganate was weakened by famine, epidemic disease and fighting among its leaders. In 840 the Kyrgyz from the Yenisei valley, helped by a rebel Uyghur general, stormed Ordu-Baliq and killed the khan.

The Uyghurs scattered. Some went to the Gansu corridor, some to the Turpan oasis, where they founded the Kingdom of Qocho, and some came south to the Tang border, where Tang forces defeated them in 843.
story_zh: 回鹘汗国自744年起统治蒙古草原，都城斡耳朵八里位于鄂尔浑河畔。安史之乱期间，回鹘派骑兵帮助唐朝收复长安和洛阳，此后又通过以马换绢的贸易发家致富。回鹘统治者信奉摩尼教。
830年代，汗国遭遇饥荒、瘟疫和内部争斗，国力衰退。840年，叶尼塞河流域的黠戛斯人在一名回鹘叛将的协助下攻破都城，杀死了可汗。
回鹘人四散迁徙：一部分迁往河西走廊，一部分到了吐鲁番绿洲，建立高昌回鹘王国，还有一部分南下唐朝边境，843年被唐军击败。
uyghur-collapse.why: The Uyghurs who settled in Turpan and Gansu became ancestors of the Turkic peoples of modern Xinjiang and Gansu, and the steppe was left without a great empire until the Khitan rose.
uyghur-collapse.why_zh: 迁往吐鲁番和河西的回鹘人，成为今天新疆和甘肃一些突厥语民族的祖先；草原上则直到契丹兴起前都没有再出现强大的帝国。

story: After the Huang Chao rebellion, the warlord Zhu Wen, a former rebel officer, became the strongest man in the empire from his base at Bianzhou (Kaifeng). By 903 he had destroyed the palace eunuchs and controlled Emperor Zhaozong.

Early in 904 Zhu Wen forced the emperor, the court and the people of Chang'an to move east to Luoyang. He had the palaces, government offices and houses of the capital dismantled, and their timbers floated down the Wei and Yellow Rivers. In the autumn his officers murdered Zhaozong and put the emperor's thirteen-year-old son on the throne.
The next year Zhu Wen had about thirty senior officials killed at Baima and their bodies thrown into the Yellow River.
story_zh: 黄巢起义之后，出身起义军将领的军阀朱温以汴州（今开封）为根据地，成为天下最强的势力。到903年，他已经铲除宫中宦官，把唐昭宗控制在手中。
904年初，朱温胁迫昭宗、朝廷百官和长安居民东迁洛阳，又下令拆毁长安的宫殿、官署和民宅，把木料顺着渭河、黄河漂运东去。这年秋天，他的部下杀死昭宗，扶立昭宗十三岁的儿子为帝。
第二年，朱温又在白马驿杀害了约三十名朝廷重臣，把尸体投入黄河。
changan-abandoned.why: Chang'an never again served as China's capital; the political centre moved east to Kaifeng and later further east and north.
changan-abandoned.why_zh: 此后长安再也没有成为中国的都城，政治中心东移到开封，后来又移向更东、更北的地方。

people.name: Zhu Wen
people.role: Warlord, later founder of Later Liang
people.role_zh: 军阀，后来的后梁开国皇帝

story: Wu Zhao had been a junior consort of Taizong. After his death she became a favourite of his son Gaozong, which many considered improper. Gaozong's wife, Empress Wang, had no son, and Wu, who bore the emperor several children, set out to replace her.

In 655 Gaozong decided to depose Empress Wang. His senior ministers, led by his uncle Zhangsun Wuji and Chu Suiliang, opposed it; Chu laid his court tablet on the steps and knocked his head until it bled. The general Li Shiji, however, told the emperor that it was his own family affair. In November Wang was deposed and Wu became empress. Wang and another consort were soon put to death, and Chu Suiliang and Zhangsun Wuji were later driven into exile.
story_zh: 武曌原是唐太宗的才人。太宗死后，她又得到太宗之子唐高宗的宠爱，许多人认为这有违礼法。高宗的王皇后没有儿子，而为高宗生了几个孩子的武昭仪，一心要取而代之。
655年，高宗决意废黜王皇后。以舅舅长孙无忌和褚遂良为首的元老重臣极力反对，褚遂良甚至把笏板放在台阶上，叩头叩到流血。大将李勣却对高宗说，这是陛下的家事。这年11月，王皇后被废，武氏被立为皇后。王皇后和另一位妃子不久被杀，褚遂良和长孙无忌后来也相继被贬逐。
wu-becomes-empress.why: Her victory broke the power of the old ministers and began her half-century domination of the Tang court.
wu-becomes-empress.why_zh: 这场胜利打破了元老重臣的势力，开启了她主宰唐朝朝政长达半个世纪的历史。

quote.zh: 此陛下家事，何必更问外人！
quote.en: This is Your Majesty's family affair. Why ask outsiders?
quote.from: Li Shiji, recorded in the Zizhi Tongjian 李勣语，见《资治通鉴》

story: When An Lushan rebelled at Fanyang, most of the cities of Hebei surrendered or were taken without a fight. The court in Chang'an had few trained troops nearby. The general Feng Changqing hurried to Luoyang and recruited about 60,000 men from the markets, but they had no experience.

The rebel cavalry crossed the Yellow River and broke Feng's army in a series of battles east of the city. About a month after the rising began, Luoyang fell. Feng retreated west to Shanzhou, joined Gao Xianzhi, and the two fell back to Tong Pass. On the false charges of a eunuch, Xuanzong had both generals executed.
At the start of 756, An Lushan proclaimed himself emperor of Yan in Luoyang.
story_zh: 安禄山在范阳起兵后，河北各城大多不战而降或被轻易攻破。长安朝廷附近缺乏训练有素的军队。大将封常清赶到洛阳，从市井中招募了约六万人，但都是没有作战经验的新兵。
叛军骑兵渡过黄河，在洛阳以东接连击溃封常清的部队。起兵约一个月后，洛阳失陷。封常清西退陕州，与高仙芝会合，一同退守潼关。唐玄宗听信宦官诬告，将两位将军一并处斩。
756年初，安禄山在洛阳称帝，国号大燕。
luoyang-falls-755.why: Losing the eastern capital so fast shocked the empire, and the execution of two experienced generals weakened its defence.
luoyang-falls-755.why_zh: 东都如此迅速地陷落震动了全国，而处死两员宿将更削弱了唐军的防御。

story: After the fall of Luoyang, the veteran general Geshu Han, partly paralysed by a stroke, took command at Tong Pass, the narrow gateway between the Yellow River and the mountains that protected Chang'an. With about 200,000 men behind strong walls, he planned to wait while loyalist forces in Hebei cut the rebels' supply lines.

The chief minister Yang Guozhong distrusted Geshu Han and persuaded Xuanzong to order him to attack. In July 756 Geshu Han led his army out, weeping. East of the pass, at Lingbao, the rebels lured it into a narrow road between hills and the river and destroyed it. Geshu Han was handed over to the rebels by his own officers.
Within days, Xuanzong fled Chang'an.
story_zh: 洛阳失守后，因中风而半身不遂的老将哥舒翰受命镇守潼关。潼关夹在黄河与群山之间，是长安的门户。他率领约二十万人凭险固守，打算等待河北的唐军切断叛军后路。
宰相杨国忠猜忌哥舒翰，说服唐玄宗下令出关进攻。756年7月，哥舒翰痛哭出关。在潼关以东的灵宝，叛军把唐军诱入山河之间的狭窄道路，将其全歼。哥舒翰被自己的部将绑送叛军。
几天之后，唐玄宗逃离长安。
tong-pass-756.why: The loss of Tong Pass opened Chang'an to the rebels and forced the emperor to flee, leading to Mawei.
tong-pass-756.why_zh: 潼关失守使长安门户大开，皇帝被迫出逃，随后便发生了马嵬驿之变。

story: After the killing of Yang Guifei at Mawei, local elders begged Xuanzong to stay and lead resistance. The old emperor went on to Sichuan, but the crown prince Li Heng, urged by his son Li Chu and the eunuch Li Fuguo, turned north with a small following.

He reached Lingwu, a garrison town on the Yellow River in modern Ningxia, where frontier troops were based. In August 756 he declared himself emperor, without his father's permission, and named Xuanzong 'retired emperor'. Xuanzong accepted when the news reached him.
From Lingwu, Suzong called in the armies of the northwest and of Guo Ziyi and Li Guangbi, and asked the Uyghurs for help.
story_zh: 马嵬驿之变后，当地父老恳请唐玄宗留下领导抗敌。年迈的玄宗还是继续前往四川，太子李亨则在儿子李俶和宦官李辅国的劝说下，带着少量随从转向北方。
他来到今宁夏境内黄河边的军镇灵武，那里驻有边防军队。756年8月，他未经父亲同意就自行即位，尊玄宗为太上皇。消息传到四川，玄宗只好接受。
唐肃宗以灵武为基地，召集西北各军以及郭子仪、李光弼的部队，并向回纥借兵。
suzong-lingwu.why: It gave the loyalists a leader near the front and began the long counteroffensive.
suzong-lingwu.why_zh: 这让平叛力量在前线附近有了领导核心，开启了漫长的反攻。

story: Suiyang, near modern Shangqiu, guarded the Bian canal route to the Huai River and the rich lands of the lower Yangtze, which were now the Tang's main source of tax and grain. Early in 757 a large rebel army under Yin Ziqi attacked it.

The local governor Xu Yuan handed military command to Zhang Xun, who had already fought the rebels nearby. With fewer than 7,000 men they held the city for about ten months, repulsing attack after attack. As food ran out the defenders ate tea leaves, paper, bark and rats, and finally, according to the histories, people.
In late 757 the starving city fell. Zhang Xun and his officers were executed. Only days later Tang forces arrived nearby, and Suiyang was soon recovered.
story_zh: 睢阳在今商丘附近，扼守通往淮河的汴河水道，屏障着长江下游的富庶之地，而那里此时已是唐朝赋税和粮食的主要来源。757年初，尹子奇率领大批叛军来攻。
睢阳太守许远把军事指挥权交给已在附近与叛军交战的张巡。他们以不足七千兵力坚守了约十个月，一次次击退进攻。粮食吃尽后，守军以茶叶、纸张、树皮和老鼠充饥，据史书记载，最后甚至以人为食。
757年底，饥饿的睢阳城陷落，张巡和部将被杀。没过几天，唐军就到了附近，很快收复了睢阳。
suiyang-siege.why: The siege kept the rebels out of the south, which saved the Tang's finances; Zhang Xun and Xu Yuan were honoured as heroes, though the cannibalism was debated.
suiyang-siege.why_zh: 这次死守阻止了叛军南下，保住了唐朝的财源。张巡、许远被尊为英雄，但守城中吃人一事也一直饱受争议。

story: By 757 the rebel side was weakened: An Lushan had been murdered by his son An Qingxu early in the year. Suzong put his eldest son Li Chu, Prince of Guangping, in nominal command, with Guo Ziyi as his deputy. The army included about 4,000 Uyghur cavalry and troops from Central Asia.

In the autumn the Tang army met the rebels at Xiangji Temple, south of Chang'an. Li Siye's infantry held the line while the Uyghur horsemen struck the rebels from behind. Tens of thousands of rebels were killed, and the rest abandoned the capital.
Tang forces retook Luoyang weeks later. The Uyghurs had been promised the right to plunder, and they looted Luoyang.
story_zh: 到757年，叛军内部已经动摇：年初安禄山被儿子安庆绪杀死。唐肃宗任命长子广平王李俶为名义上的统帅，郭子仪为副元帅，军中还有约四千回纥骑兵和来自中亚的部队。
这年秋天，唐军与叛军在长安城南的香积寺一带决战。李嗣业率步兵顶住正面，回纥骑兵从背后突袭叛军。叛军死伤数万，其余弃城而逃。
几周后，唐军又收复洛阳。回纥事先得到了可以抢掠的许诺，在洛阳大肆劫掠。
changan-recaptured-757.why: Retaking the two capitals restored the dynasty's standing, though the war went on for six more years.
changan-recaptured-757.why_zh: 收复两京恢复了唐朝的声威，不过战争又持续了六年。

people.name: Li Chu
people.role: Prince of Guangping, later Emperor Daizong

story: In the winter of 806 Bai Juyi, then a young official at Zhouzhi county near Chang'an, visited a local temple with his friends Chen Hong and Wang Zhifu. Their talk turned to Emperor Xuanzong and Yang Guifei, whose story was still told in the region fifty years after her death. Wang suggested that Bai write a poem about it.

The result was a ballad of 120 lines. It tells how the emperor fell in love and neglected his duties, how Yang Guifei died at Mawei, how he mourned her, and how a Daoist magician found her spirit on an island of immortals, where she sent back tokens and a secret vow. Chen Hong wrote a prose version to go with it.
story_zh: 806年冬，在长安附近的盩厔县做县尉的白居易，与朋友陈鸿、王质夫同游当地的仙游寺。谈话间说起唐玄宗和杨贵妃的往事，杨贵妃已经死去五十年，她的故事仍在当地流传。王质夫提议白居易为此写一首诗。
于是有了这首一百二十句的长篇叙事诗。诗中讲述皇帝如何沉迷爱情、荒废朝政，杨贵妃如何死于马嵬，皇帝如何日夜思念，以及一位道士如何在海上仙山找到她的魂魄，她托道士带回信物和当年的私密誓言。陈鸿还为它写了一篇散文《长恨歌传》。
everlasting-regret.why: The poem became one of the most famous in Chinese and was hugely popular in Japan, shaping how the story of Xuanzong and Yang Guifei is remembered.
everlasting-regret.why_zh: 这首诗成为中国最著名的诗篇之一，在日本也广为流传，深刻塑造了后人对唐玄宗与杨贵妃故事的记忆。

people.name: Chen Hong
people.role: Friend who wrote the prose version

quote.zh: 天长地久有时尽，此恨绵绵无绝期。
quote.en: Heaven lasts and earth endures, yet both will one day end; this sorrow goes on and on, and will never cease.
quote.from: Bai Juyi, Song of Everlasting Regret 白居易《长恨歌》
